Photo 1 shows a leaning stack with visible KAR and HT stamps, darker weathered wood, and one pallet propped vertically on the left.
Photo 2 shows a stack topped with a plywood sheet, with visible HT stamps and mixed lighter and darker wood.
No brand or model plate is visible; markings are standard pallet stamps only.
Seller text describes the item generically as wooden pallets and gives no quantity, condition, or brand claims.
